scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/types build && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/sdk build && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/ui build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/types typecheck && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/ui typecheck
scripts.postinstall: pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/types exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/sdk exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @dumb-pipe/ui exec tsc --noEmit
